name: Giddy Up: target an enemy while riding -> off the mount in range; after the fight -> mounted again (on foot to start, one enemy within ~20 y in view, nothing else hostile nearby, the fight handled as usual)

steps.msg: start on foot, out of combat
enemy dismount (in range) and mount after combat should be on
the enemy watcher should run while riding
Giddy Up should see the enemy target
the enemy should be within attack range and Giddy Up should dismount (if not: the probe's ride=Approaching gap/range shows how far it is)
you should be off the mount
Giddy Up should want to mount after the fight
the mount should come once you're done (about one GCD after your last action)
the mount should be Giddy Up's
